Adolion: Crimsonwing & Ebonwing
Author view
Overview
Memory
⚑
Where you are
What Unira Says
At the dungeon under the keep.
Unira, freed and still in the rags of her gambeson, has started to talk, and the stair back up has come down behind you.
Things are close to breaking.
About this story
Your C-rank party is back at the Aegis City Adventurers Guild, and the counter is offering work above your rank: a joint posting with one of the Guild's two famous high-rank parties, Crimsonwing or Ebonwing, to clear a border fort in the Velniran foothills where a rogue lord is buying captives. Expect a hard, dark delve beside partners who are polite, ruthless and proud of their record. Play the Nightriver heir who leads the party, with Belle and Dalan at your side.
Recently
You left The Prisoner in the Cells behind and moved into What Unira Says.
Max Nightriver and the captive descended the spiral stair beneath the Great Hall, past an iron-barred gate, into a dark corridor of stone cells where the demon-reek was stronger and the captive revealed that the Beastmen were still present. At the far end, in the lowest cell, they found a gaunt, silver-haired woman hunched in the corner who did not look up as the torchlight reached her. The tone was tense and oppressive, heavy with fear and foreboding.
Open threads
A Beastman shaman and three Beastmen have cornered the party at the lowest cell and demand they surrender Unira.
Unira cannot walk and must be carried out while the shaman closes in.
The Beastman shaman's brand can compel Unira, and the party must get her out before he can give her an order.
The party must decide whether to expose the Wind Ballad's betrayal and the Guild's false report of Unira's death, or honor Unira's plea to let them keep thinking she is dead.
The story so far
Max Nightriver's party chose Ced of Crimsonwing over Kela of Ebonwing for a joint Guild posting to a Velniran foothills fort taking captives, swayed by Crimsonwing's record and Ced's dawn-departure discipline. Ced led Max, Runo, and Dalan north from Aegis City with a mule of alchemical supplies and a covered cart of Runo's magitech golems, taking a steeper, less-watched path to Carrow Keep. On the march Runo confessed the failed last expedition was his fault and that he had failed Crimsonwing's last member.
